description.raw: '''Passive:''' '''Jarvan IV''' gains [[File:Attack speed icon.png|15px|link=Attack speed]] '''bonus''' attack speed.
description.text: Passive: Jarvan IV gains  bonus attack speed.

description2.raw: '''Active:''' '''Jarvan IV''' throws a Demacian flag to the target location, dealing magic damage to enemies within the area.
description2.text: Active: Jarvan IV throws a Demacian flag to the target location, dealing magic damage to enemies within the area.

description3.raw: The flag then remains for 8 seconds, granting [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] of its surroundings and providing an [[File:Aria of Perseverance.png|20px|link=Aura|An icon representing the keyword Aura]] [[:Aura|aura]] that grants ''Demacian Standard's'' passive '''bonus''' attack speed to all nearby allied champions as well as '''Jarvan IV''' himself.
description3.text: The flag then remains for 8 seconds, granting sight of its surroundings and providing an aura that grants Demacian Standard's passive bonus attack speed to all nearby allied champions as well as Jarvan IV himself.

leveling2.raw:
'''Magic Damage:'''
80 / 120 / 160 / 200 / 240 (+ 80% AP)

notes.raw: * The attack speed granted from a deployed ''Demacian Standard'' [[File:Additive stacking icon.png|20px|link=Stacking#Stacks_additively|An icon representing the keyword Stacks additively]] [[:Stacking#Stacks_additively|stacks additively]] with ''Demacian Standard's'' passive permanent bonus attack speed to '''Jarvan IV''', but the aura from multiple ''Demacian Standards'' does not stack. ** '''Jarvan IV''' gains a total of 40 / 45 / 50 / 55 / 60% bonus attack speed from ''Demacian Standard'' while near the flag. * The flag has a 13.6 [[File:Pathing radius.png|20px|link=Unit collision|An icon representing the keyword Pathing radius]] [[:Unit collision|pathing radius]] and a 65 [[File:Gameplay radius.png|20px|link=Unit size|An icon representing the keyword Gameplay radius]] [[:Unit size|gameplay radius]]. ** The gameplay radius matters to [[File:Jarvan IV Dragon Strike.png|20xpx|border|link=Jarvan IV#Dragon Strike|An icon for Jarvan IV's ability Dragon Strike]] [[Jarvan IV#Dragon Strike|Dragon Strike]]. * ''Demacian Standard'' can be targeted by allied abilities ([[File:Teleport.png|20xpx|border|link=Teleport|An icon representing Teleport]] [[Teleport]], [[File:Lee Sin Safeguard.png|20xpx|border|link=Lee Sin#Safeguard|An icon for Lee Sin's ability Safeguard]] [[Lee Sin#Safeguard|Safeguard]]). The target type is the same as a [[File:Minion icon.png|20px|link=Minion|An icon representing the keyword Minion]] [[:Minion|minion]]. * ''Demacian Standard'' is [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]] to enemies.
notes.text:
The attack speed granted from a deployed Demacian Standard stacks additively with Demacian Standard's passive permanent bonus attack speed to Jarvan IV, but the aura from multiple Demacian Standards does not stack.
* Jarvan IV gains a total of 40 / 45 / 50 / 55 / 60% bonus attack speed from Demacian Standard while near the flag.
The flag has a 13.6 pathing radius and a 65 gameplay radius.
* The gameplay radius matters to Dragon Strike.
Demacian Standard can be targeted by allied abilities ( Teleport, Safeguard). The target type is the same as a minion.
Demacian Standard is untargetable to enemies.
